content.text: {"customer_value_line":"Frank Delacroix said dispatch needs to see every truck in real time, and that real time is non negotiable.","rows":[{"milestone":"Apex hosting team answer on Canadian data residency","customer_owner":"","apex_owner":"Omar Haddad","target_date":"2026-10-01","status":"agreed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U027","excerpt":"I'll check with our hosting team on Canadian residency and come back by Thursday, October 1st."},{"utterance_id":"U028","excerpt":"Good."}]},{"milestone":"Customer settles whether Canadian contracts require telematics data to stay in Canada, and shares the contract clause and the legal contact","customer_owner":"Frank Delacroix","apex_owner":"Leah Brennan","target_date":"","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U013","excerpt":"Our Canadian contracts say shipment data stays in Canada."},{"utterance_id":"U014","excerpt":"I don't think that applies to telematics data."}]},{"milestone":"Align on seat count and scope: 50 seats for dispatch versus 400 seats including finance and regional offices","customer_owner":"Frank Delacroix","apex_owner":"Leah Brennan","target_date":"","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U024","excerpt":"Get me pricing for 50 seats."},{"utterance_id":"U025","excerpt":"I'd rather see pricing for 400, so we don't get surprised later."}]},{"milestone":"Pricing shown for both 50 and 400 seats","customer_owner":"","apex_owner":"Leah Brennan","target_date":"","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U026","excerpt":"We can show both."}]},{"milestone":"Name who signs for this purchase and set a dated next meeting","customer_owner":"Frank Delacroix","apex_owner":"Leah Brennan","target_date":"","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U023","excerpt":"For next steps, what would be most useful?"}]}]}
